dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just where are you running to, Benoit?

dialogues.speaker: Benoit Leroy
dialogues.text: The house was hers anyway, so if she takes it back, then she takes it back. It's fine...

dialogues.speaker: Benoit Leroy
dialogues.text: If I lose my life... No, I can't lose it... Here, still, I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Benoit! We almost couldn't keep up! ...Why did you suddenly start running so fast?
If the stem breaks, the cradle will fall...
Yet I will catch you, cradle and all...
